shape_assertions: Root is OOP action; root child for actual Action::Check (assert index0) is IP action. Both have exactly requested NA and remain in active plan action lists.

Both menus have Check followed by exactly the A-1 distinct ascending Bet amounts produced by the fixed source expressions. Compare action tags and f64 amount bits across arms; fail if clamping/deduplication changes cardinality.

Only those two nodes have target high arity; all facing responses have Fold/Call (NA2), no chance nodes or raises. Source-derived total nodes=6*A-3, at most99; assert actual count and full ordered tree/action/children identity.

schedule.requirements: Both nodes unlocked; ordinary iterate exercises initial eager iteration then capture/replay. Assert graph absent initially, present after iteration2, and nonzero learned strategy for each actor. Take snapshot.

After the first full readback, Freeze root/OOP and Check/IP using existing lock_node with fixed distinct labels. Verify exactly these2 lock entries and sigma lengths/finite frequencies. update_locks must clear graphs; ordinary next iteration captures again. Take snapshot with both locks retained.

Save locked CPU state through existing API, drop GPU, load_with_storage using same storage. Explicitly restore case algorithm and use_isomorphism=false because save Header does not encode algorithm. Verify loaded iteration57 and both locks/labels, graph absent initially and present after first warm iterate. Five ordinary iterations then snapshot.

snapshot_order: Drain via existing synchronous clone_dtoh helper and persist all six complete device images: d_regrets[0/1], d_strat[0/1], d_reach[0/1], each f32::to_bits in labeled length-framed little-endian data BEFORE sync_to_cpu, exploitability or CPU queries. This is essential for compressed cases. Do not compare inactive/unwritten d_cfv scratch.

Call original full sync_to_cpu. Persist complete Store payloads for regrets/strategy of both actors: every F32 bit, or every signed/unsigned q value and every scale bit (including otherwise unused scale entries), preserving storage tag and lengths.

Record exact iteration/algo, complete canonical lock data by node ID with sigma float bits and labels; call original exploitability and record exact bits, then original root and Check/IP node_view snapshots with all numeric bits preserved.

Save with existing API. Compare magic, complete header values (canonicalize only ordering of unique lock/label entries by node ID), each arena length and ALL raw payload bytes. Never normalize float values, drop fields or compare only file/FNV hashes. Whole .gto byte hashes are evidence only: HashMap lock header order can vary between processes.
After all checkpoints, compare every fixed case/phase between arms; report first mismatch plus retained full raw files. Compression or tolerance may never hide a raw-device mismatch.

Any mismatch/missing case is failed or incomplete qualification, not permission to narrow matrix.
